name: projectile-trajectory

error.message: There are 11 equations and 12 variables. The problem is underspecified and cannot be solved. Free quantity (no defining relation): x. Coupled to: t, time, v, vy, y. A common cause: an element chain with no constitutive law for that quantity — e.g. an efficiency-only machine or rigid pass-through between boundaries leaves its through-flow or a port pressure free; add an orifice/valve/flow-map element or pin a boundary value.
